summary: OpenCode's models page lists Inkling 2 Small Free (model ID inkling-2-small-free) as available for a limited time, priced free input, output and cached reads. Its provider retains your data and may use it for model training. It's not available in the European Union, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, or Venezuela. Free-tier chat models only work from within OpenCode. OpenCode's product FAQ says its free models can be used without creating an account. No end date is published.
claim_steps: Use it while the limited-time free period lasts; free-tier models work only from within OpenCode
